adoption.notes: From fc72969e the runtime holds the approver registry: its header records the device, site and epoch bindings, it refuses device_binding_mismatch and site_binding_mismatch as this version requires, and it serves recover, local seed, enrol, revocation and the binding readback through operator-socket/v3. It runs this version's transitions corpus, vendored at 3596a5e: every scenario passes as far as any step that opens or admits a Tier C proposal, and apply_provisioning is modelled, since this runtime applies a provisioning document only at start. It has no phone ingress, so a phone candidate is refused channel_unauthenticated; no Tier C admission against the registry; no refusal of proposal opening or admission under a binding mismatch; no proposal cutoff; and no LAN disclosure or its denial. Its release notes and module docstrings name this version as the draft the socket carries, and its capability matrix records the approver registry as Partial, so the version is not frozen by this merge: under VERSIONING's Freeze Rule an explicitly partial implementation does not freeze, and naming the contract a component serves is provenance. It has no release, and its evidence is host tests and CI.

notes: Proposal for a runtime-owned Tier C human approver registry. The runtime implements the registry and its local operations on its main branch, with Tier C admission, phone ingress, the proposal cutoff and LAN disclosure still to come; no conformance proof is recorded.
